verdicts.reason: A is a shrunk copy of the original. The quote is set small, and the vertical 'KURT VONNEGUT' credit is tiny and hard to read. The green horizontal stub floats on its own instead of running off the left edge, and the purple top rule stops short of the right edge. The whole frame sits in the middle of the canvas, leaving empty bands at the left and right. B keeps the quote large and strong and the credit readable, and it uses the wide format better. Its flaws: the green vertical is cut short at top and bottom instead of running off the canvas, the purple vertical now pokes above its horizontal rule, the purple top rule stops just short of the right edge, and the red rule sits very close to the bottom end of the green line.
